plugin.name: Tasks Map
plugin.description: A graph view of your tasks

commands.focus_project_or_task: Focus project or task in map
commands.insert_filter_as_code_block: Insert current filter as embedded Tasks Map

view.title: Tasks map
view.dataview_required: Tasks Map requires the Dataview plugin to be installed and enabled.
view.dataview_not_installed: The Dataview plugin is not currently installed.
view.dataview_disabled: The Dataview plugin is installed but not enabled.
view.visit_community_plugins: Visit the Community Plugins section in Settings to install or enable Dataview.

settings.show_task_priorities_desc: Display priority indicators on task nodes
settings.priority_accent_position_desc: Choose where the priority color strip appears on task nodes
settings.show_status_counts_desc: Display a status counts overlay on the canvas
settings.attachment_type_markdown_desc: Show owned attachment notes under task nodes
settings.attachment_type_pdf_desc: Show PDF attachments under task nodes
settings.attachment_type_image_desc: Show common image attachments under task nodes
settings.attachment_type_file_desc: Show non-note file attachments under task nodes
settings.editor_autosave_desc: Write changes in the task editor panel to disk automatically as you type. When off, an explicit Save button is shown.
settings.edge_style_desc: The line style used for connections between nodes
settings.smooth_step_radius_desc: Border radius for smooth step corners (0 = sharp right angles)
settings.sidebar_width_desc: Width in pixels of the left sidebar (unlinked tasks and project tree panels)
settings.tag_color_palette_desc: Choose a color theme for tags
settings.task_statuses_desc: Configure the available task statuses. Each status maps to a checkbox character (for Tasks-plugin tasks) and one or more frontmatter values (for note-based tasks).
settings.task_priorities_desc: Configure priority values from the TaskNotes task type file, or fall back to Task Map's own saved priorities. Colors are saved by Task Map.
settings.tasknotes_schema_use_desc: Read and write priority values from the vault's task type definition when available.
settings.tasknotes_schema_path_desc: Vault-relative path to the TaskNotes task type definition.
settings.tasknotes_schema_unsaved: Priority changes are not written to the task type file until you apply them.
settings.tasknotes_schema_write_empty: Add at least one priority before applying.
settings.tasknotes_schema_write_failed: Could not update the TaskNotes task type file.
settings.default_status_filter_desc: Statuses shown when the map is opened. Enabling every status (or disabling every status) shows them all.
settings.linking_style_desc: How task dependencies are specified in simple tasks
settings.linking_individual_desc: Each dependency with its own emoji identifier
settings.linking_dataview_desc: Dependencies using Dataview inline field syntax
settings.note_task_property_name_desc: The frontmatter property used to identify a note as a task (e.g. "tags" or "type")
settings.note_task_property_value_desc: A note is treated as a task when the property above contains one of these values. Separate multiple values with commas (e.g. "task, project")
settings.note_dependency_property_desc: The frontmatter property holding dependency note links (e.g. "blockedBy" or "projects"). Accepts a list of [[wiki links]].
settings.debug_visualization_desc: Show additional debug information in the graph view
settings.language_desc: Select the language for the plugin interface
